# MP365 (Modern Partners 365)

> MP365 is a Microsoft consulting partner based in Vernon, Connecticut, specializing in Microsoft 365 M&A tenant migration, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and data governance for mid-market and enterprise organizations. Founded on 20+ years of Microsoft platform experience, MP365 positions itself against large systems integrators by delivering senior expertise without a multi-month discovery cycle.

Key facts: Legal name Modern Partners 365. Headquartered at 59 Winding Brook Trail, Vernon, CT 06066. Phone +1 (860) 208-9537. Email info@mp-365.com. Serves Connecticut, New England, and clients nationwide. Leadership: Mohammed Khaliefa (President, 20+ years Microsoft platform leadership) and Dr. Raafat Elfouly (CTO, Ph.D., author of 50+ published papers).

## Services

- [M&A Tenant Migration](https://mp-365.com/services/ma-tenant-migration/): Tenant-to-tenant Microsoft 365 migration for mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures.
- [Microsoft 365 Migration](https://mp-365.com/services/microsoft-365-migration/): Fully managed migration from Google Workspace, on-prem Exchange, or another cloud into Microsoft 365.
- [Dynamics 365 Consulting](https://mp-365.com/services/dynamics-365/): CRM and ERP implementation — Sales, Customer Service, Business Central, Finance & Operations.
- [Power Platform Solutions](https://mp-365.com/services/power-platform/): Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and Copilot Studio, with governance built in.
- [Data Governance](https://mp-365.com/services/data-governance/): Microsoft Purview-based retention, classification, and access governance.
- [Application Modernization](https://mp-365.com/services/application-modernization/): Legacy application migration and re-architecture on Azure.
- [Collaboration Enablement](https://mp-365.com/services/collaboration-enablement/): SharePoint, Teams, and enterprise search restructuring.
- [Contract Management Enablement](https://mp-365.com/services/contract-management/): Automated contract workflows replacing email-based tracking.
